questions.question: Which of the following best describes UDP?

answers.d: A protocol with built-in error correction

questions.question: Why is UDP suitable for real-time applications like VoIP and video streaming?

answers.a: It guarantees error-free delivery of data
answers.b: It minimizes latency by avoiding retransmissions

questions.question: Which characteristic of UDP allows it to send messages without establishing a connection?
Which technique can be used to improve reliability when using UDP?

answers.a: Using a retransmission mechanism at the application layer
